name: Sŏn Operational Systems Build Out
text_content:
Parent task for work items surfaced by the Scaling People translation program. Typed subtasks land here as sessions produce them.

Every subtask carries exactly one type:

Type Meaning
Founder decision A choice requiring one or more founders to ratify
Document A founding document, policy statement, or philosophy to write
Process A cadence, workflow, or operating rhythm to design
Instrument A tool, template, rubric, scorecard, or form to build
Structure An organizational design element to finalize
Instrument production is gated on the document methodology, task 86ajgn2z5. Nothing typed Instrument gets built until that lands.

This task holds work items only. Decisions and specifications live in the Sŏn Operating System doc, 2ky45bmy-17253. Cross-session couplings live in the Carryover Register, list 901327884538.

Program parent task: 86ajgmh9a. Tracker: 2ky45bmy-17233.
